Kit summary

Fang ArrowBasic
Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If the target has [Poison] or [Viper Venom], there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns; and deals extra 220% ATK [Poison] DMG. Otherwise, deals extra 220% ATK DMG that ignores DEF.
Poisonous Arrow RainActive
Deals 100% ATK DMG to all enemies. If the targets have [Poison] or [Viper Venom], there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns, with a 80% chance to reduce the targets' ATK by 40% for 2 turns. Otherwise, deals extra 260% ATK DMG that ignores DEF.
Bone-rotting PoisonPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Fang Arrow inflicts 1 layer of [Viper Venom] on the target with [Poison] for 5 turns, up to 3 layers. As for the target without [Poison], additionally increases Fang Arrow's Crit Rate by 30% and Crit DMG by 60%. Also, after Poisonous Arrow Rain or Viper Twist deals DMG, all layers of [Viper Venom] will be detonated. For every 1 layer of [Viper Venom] detonated, reduces the CD of all her skills by 1 turn and deals DMG based on the layer(s) detonated: 1 layer: 920% ATK [Poison] DMG 2 layers: 1380% ATK [Poison] DMG 3 layers: 1840% ATK [Poison] DMG The CD of Poisonous Arrow Rain or Viper Twist is not affected by anyone other than Zora herself. DMG dealt by detonating [Viper Venom] is considered as Skill DMG.
Fang Bow Lv.1When Zora detonates [Viper Venom], there is a 40% chance at least and an 80% chance at most to reduce the target's SPD by 40% for 2 turns. The more layers detonated, the higher the chance. Also, if Zora never detonates [Viper Venom] for 3 consecutive turns, increases self Crit DMG by 60% for 2 turns at the end of the 3rd turn.
Fang Bow Lv.2Increases all extra DMG dealt by Zora by 15% and the DMG dealt by detonating [Viper Venom] by 15%.
Fang Bow Lv.3When Zora enters a battle, additionally gains 20% Mastery and 20% Crit DMG for 3 turns. If Zora has detonated [Viper Venom] before the effect ends, increases Zora's ATK by 20% and Mastery by 80% till the battle ends. Otherwise, increases Zora's ATK by 20% and Crit DMG by 80% till the battle ends.
Viper TwistActive
Deals 3 stages of 50% ATK DMG each to all enemies. If the target has [Poison] or [Viper Venom], each stage deals extra 120% ATK [Poison] DMG. Otherwise, each stage deals extra 120% ATK DMG that ignores DEF.
